title: Cookie/Session Attacks
description: Four paths: forgery, fixation, decryption, and injection
detail:
1. Inspect the structure: base64-decode it to view fields (user/role/isAdmin are common)
2. Serialized strings: rO0AB (Java) / Tzoy (PHP "O:2:") → see the deserialization entry
3. Decryptable sessions (leaked key/weak key): Flask unsign and unpickle deserialization RCE (inject into the .level field)
4. Forgery: change fields such as role=admin and re-sign (obtain the key from a git leak/configuration)
5. Fixation: session not invalidated after logout / session ID set before login
6. JWT: see the dedicated entry
7. OAuth/OIDC: redirect_uri issues, missing state causing CSRF, code replay
8. Auto-binding parameter pollution: pass extra fields such as role during registration (mass assignment)
